title: ext-knowledge mock attach configuration
description: Machine-local configuration consumed by the suite worker when a case declares an ext-served logical mock service. Never committed with real values.

runner_url.description: Runner-facing control-plane root, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:30090. Must be a pure root address (no path, no trailing slash, no credentials).

product_url.description: Product-container-facing root, e.g. http://ext-knowledge:30090. Same root-address rules; it may equal runner_url only for a host-mode product deployment that shares the runner loopback.

compose_project.description: Compose project the instance runs under (informational for operators).

product_network.description: Product network the instance is attached to (informational for operators).

owner_run_id.description: Identity of the owning deployment run; must match the instance's reported run_id.

source_revision.description: Checkout revision the image was built from; must match the instance identity.

build_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the packed build manifest; must match the instance identity.

lock_directory.description: Machine-local directory shared across test-homes holding the per-endpoint lock and attach state files. Absolute path.

logical_services.description: Explicit mapping of which logical mock services THIS ext instance serves. Cases whose required_mock_services intersect this list attach to it; other providers (e.g. the controlled test-assets service) are never redirected here implicitly.
